msw ^3.0.3: peers vite >=6, typescript >=5.9 (both optional, both met); graphql is an optional peer and not needed; engines node >=22.12.

vitest-axe ^0.1.0: the last stable release (1.0 is still pre-release); peers vitest >=0.16 (met). Its type augmentation targets the old Vi namespace, so test-server.ts declares the matcher on vitest's Matchers.
